summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6, buck): evaluated 14 same-category OPNs, surfacing 0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 2 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 6 Level 3 Layout Change options. Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_advantage: Texas Instruments multi-source option in SOT-23-6
candidates.key_tradeoff: Higher Iq (120 µA vs 45 µA); Lower Vin,max (17 V vs 28 V)

candidates.key_advantage: Diodes Incorporated multi-source option in TSOT-23-6
candidates.key_tradeoff: Higher Iq (135 µA vs 45 µA); Lower current rating (2000 mA vs 3000 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Package change (SOT-23-6 → TSOT-23-6) requires PCB layout mod; Lower current rating (2000 mA vs 3000 mA)

selection_checklist: Confirm topology (buck, synchronous), pinout, and exposed thermal pad (None) on SOT-23-6.
Re-verify switching frequency (400 kHz), inductor value (10 µH), and inductor Isat margin (>= 25% above peak switch current).
Check feedback reference Vref (0.596 V) and recalculate R1/R2 divider plus feedforward cap before power-up.
Audit hot-loop ceramic input/output capacitance placement and thermal dissipation at worst-case Vin and ambient temperature.
